# Huong dan chay du an `web`
Tai lieu nay huong dan 3 viec chinh: - Clone project ve may - Khoi tao database tu file `data/electro_db.sql` - Cau hinh va chay project bang Tomcat Server trong IntelliJ IDEA
## 1) Yeu cau moi truong
Can cai dat truoc: - Git - JDK 21 (du an dang dung Java 21 trong `pom.xml`) - MySQL 8.x - IntelliJ IDEA - Apache Tomcat 10.1+ (du an dung `jakarta.servlet-api` 6.x)
Kiem tra nhanh trong PowerShell:
```powershell java -version .\mvnw.cmd -v ```
## 2) Clone project
```powershell git clone <URL_REPOSITORY> cd web ```
> Thay `<URL_REPOSITORY>` bang link Git cua ban.
## 3) Khoi tao database tu `electro_db.sql`
### 3.1 Tao database moi
Dang nhap MySQL:
```powershell mysql -u root -p ```
Trong MySQL shell:
```sql CREATE DATABASE cellphoneS CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci; EXIT; ```
> Ten DB o tren dang dat la `cellphoneS` de khop voi `JDBCUtils` hien tai.
### 3.2 Import file SQL
Tu thu muc goc project (`web`), chay:
```powershell mysql -u root -p cellphoneS < .\data\electro_db.sql ```
## 4) Cau hinh ket noi database
Project dang cau hinh DB tai file `src/main/java/com/daizuongkk/web/util/JDBCUtils.java`.
Can cap nhat 3 gia tri sau cho dung may cua ban: - `DB_URL` - `USER` - `PASSWORD`
Vi du:
```java private static final String DB_URL = "jdbc:mysql://localhost:3306/cellphoneS?useSSL=false&allowPublicKeyRetrieval=true&serverTimezone=UTC"; private static final String USER = "root"; private static final String PASSWORD = "your_password"; ```
## 5) Mo project trong IntelliJ IDEA
1. Mo IntelliJ IDEA 2. Chon **Open** va tro den thu muc `web` 3. Doi IDE import Maven project xong 4. Kiem tra JDK cua project la Java 21 (File -> Project Structure -> Project SDK)
## 6) Cau hinh Tomcat Server trong IntelliJ
### 6.1 Khai bao Tomcat local
1. Vao **Run -> Edit Configurations...** 2. Nhan **+** -> chon **Tomcat Server -> Local** 3. O tab **Server**, bam **Configure...** 4. Chon thu muc Tomcat Home (vi du `C:\tools\apache-tomcat-10.1.x`) 5. Chon JRE/JDK = Java 21
### 6.2 Tao Artifact de deploy
1. Vao **File -> Project Structure... -> Artifacts** 2. Nhan **+** -> **Web Application: Exploded** 3. Chon module `web` 4. Bam **Apply**
### 6.3 Gan artifact vao Tomcat
1. Quay lai **Run -> Edit Configurations...** 2. Chon cau hinh Tomcat vua tao 3. Mo tab **Deployment** 4. Nhan **+** va chon artifact (vi du `web:war exploded`) 5. Dat **Application context** la `/web` (hoac `/` neu muon root)
### 6.4 Chay server
- Nhan **Run** voi cau hinh Tomcat - Mo trinh duyet: - `http://localhost:8080/web` (neu context la `/web`) - `http://localhost:8080/` (neu context la `/`)
## 7) Loi thuong gap
- Port 8080 bi trung: - Doi port trong Tomcat config sang 8081. - MySQL Access denied: - Kiem tra lai `USER`/`PASSWORD` trong `JDBCUtils`. - 404 khi truy cap: - Kiem tra lai `Application context` va artifact da deploy. - Khong thay artifact trong Deployment: - Tao lai artifact o muc **Project Structure -> Artifacts**.
## 8) Build war bang Maven (tuy chon)
```powershell .\mvnw.cmd clean package ```
File WAR se nam trong thu muc `target`.
